scope: Derived presentation fields only. No gameplay timers, stats, saved fields or schema changes.

fields.barrier: Existing active absorption amount; zero after expiry.
fields.barrierRemaining: Seconds remaining at packet generation if active absorption is positive; otherwise zero.
fields.protectionRemaining: Seconds remaining on wardUntil at packet generation, clamped at zero.
fields.protectionFactor: Active wardFactor multiplier used by GameWorld._damage_player; one after expiry. 0.6 means the ward stage multiplies damage by 0.6 before other mitigation/rounding.

clock: Relative seconds, never server monotonic absolute timestamps. Presence pause/reconnect shifts the underlying timers through the existing authoritative rules.
depletedBarrier: barrierRemaining becomes zero when absorption is exhausted. Other passive conditions that still use barrierUntil are not represented by this absorption timer.
auras: Some standing-area wards refresh in 0.15-second pulses. Do not invent a longer duration or display noisy decimal countdowns.
olderServers: If remaining/factor fields are absent, keep existing amount-only presentation or omit duration; never infer a default timer.
integrationStatus: Source implementation and focused regressions complete; not activated on existing live servers or included in frozen candidate h. Visual timer presentation remains separate.
